newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end mixed after quiet session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end mixed after quiet session.

text.p: Aug 19 - U.S. debt futures ended mixed after a quiet session overall. Long end firm, short end sags as curve flattening bias seen, traders said. Sept T-bond reaches 114-14/32 session high, just short of 114-15/32 key retracement. Only slight impact seen after FOMC stands pat on rates, as expected. ((Chicago Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750))
